hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes against its own bonding curve, takes input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, verifies the curve invariant, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta — entirely replacing the standard Uniswap v4 concentrated-liquidity math. Add-liquidity and donate are blocked by design.
